notes: Main selector follows the assigned route exactly: root_table user_teams (WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP) joins via user_teams.team_id to teams (WORKSPACE) and via channels.team_id to channels (CONVERSATION), with the admin-role condition applied at the root node (user_teams.role = 'admin') and the channel identified by its user-facing name ('old-project-q3'), per the binding_note. This yields exactly the two admin memberships (U03ROBERT23, U07MORGANFREE) in T01WORKSPACE, matching target_roles. Excluded: the two same-workspace member-role users (John Doe, Hubert Marek) fail the admin-role filter; Zoe Chen's admin membership is correctly excluded because it belongs to T02BETA (Beta Testers Guild), a workspace that does not join to the old-project-q3 channel via the required teams->channels FK path. old-project-q3 is a public, non-DM channel, so conversations.list/conversations.info discovery does not require channel membership; no additional actor memberships were added. Solver access to the second workspace (T02BETA) is not needed and not assumed, consistent with the single-workspace scope of users.list/users.info; Zoe's membership is excluded structurally by the route rather than by any access limitation.
